  Rotates the app log directory and restarts the app service on a single EC2 instance,
  then verifies instance status and sends a notification.

parameters:

    type: String
    description: '(Required) ARN of the least-privilege IAM role Automation assumes.'
    allowedPattern: '^arn:aws:iam::[0-9]{12}:role/[A-Za-z0-9+=,.@_/-]{1,128}$'
  InstanceId:
    type: String
    description: '(Required) Target EC2 instance.'
    allowedPattern: '^i-(?:[a-f0-9]{8}|[a-f0-9]{17})$'
  LogPath:
    type: String
    description: 'Log directory to rotate. Must be under /var/log/myapp.'

    maxChars: 128
    allowedPattern: '^/var/log/myapp(/[A-Za-z0-9_-][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)*$'

    default: myapp.service
    allowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_@-]{1,64}\.service$'

    onFailure: Abort
    timeoutSeconds: 300

      DocumentName: AWS-RunShellScript
      InstanceIds: ['{{ InstanceId }}']
      TimeoutSeconds: 120
      CloudWatchOutputConfig:
        CloudWatchOutputEnabled: true
        CloudWatchLogGroupName: /ssm/runbooks/app-log-rotation
      Parameters:
        commands:
          - |
            set -euo pipefail
            umask 077
            LOG_DIR="$(realpath -e -- '{{ LogPath }}')"
            case "$LOG_DIR" in
              /var/log/myapp|/var/log/myapp/*) ;;
              *) echo "Refusing to operate outside /var/log/myapp: $LOG_DIR" >&2; exit 1 ;;

            install -d -m 0700 -o root -g root /var/backups/myapp
            ARCHIVE="/var/backups/myapp/logs-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).tgz"
            tar -czf "$ARCHIVE" -C "$LOG_DIR" .
            tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE" > /dev/null          # verify before deleting anything
            find "$LOG_DIR" -xdev -mindepth 1 -delete
            echo "Rotated $LOG_DIR -> $ARCHIVE"

  - name: RestartService
    action: aws:runCommand
    onFailure: Abort
    timeoutSeconds: 180
    inputs:
      DocumentName: AWS-RunShellScript
      InstanceIds: ['{{ InstanceId }}']
      TimeoutSeconds: 120
      CloudWatchOutputConfig:
        CloudWatchOutputEnabled: true
        CloudWatchLogGroupName: /ssm/runbooks/app-log-rotation
      Parameters:
        commands:
          - |
            set -euo pipefail
            systemctl restart '{{ ServiceName }}'
            systemctl is-active --quiet '{{ ServiceName }}'

  - name: Wait
    action: aws:sleep
    inputs:
      Duration: PT10S

  - name: CheckHealth
    action: aws:executeScript
    onFailure: Abort
    onCancel: Abort
    timeoutSeconds: 120
    inputs:
      Runtime: python3.11
      Handler: handler
      InputPayload:
        instanceId: '{{ InstanceId }}'
      Script: |-
        import boto3

        def handler(events, context):
            ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
            resp = ec2.describe_instance_status(

            statuses = resp.get('InstanceStatuses', [])

                raise Exception('Instance not found')

                'state': s['InstanceState']['Name'],
                'instanceStatus': s['InstanceStatus']['Status'],
                'systemStatus': s['SystemStatus']['Status'],

    onFailure: Continue

    timeoutSeconds: 60

      DocumentName: AWS-RunShellScript
      InstanceIds: ['{{ InstanceId }}']
      TimeoutSeconds: 30

    description: 'Log directory to rotate. Must be under /var/log/myapp.'
    default: /var/log/myapp
    maxChars: 128
    allowedPattern: '^/var/log/myapp(/[A-Za-z0-9_-][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)*$'
  ServiceName:
    type: String
    default: myapp.service
    allowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_@-]{1,64}\.service$'
mainSteps:
  - name: RotateLogs
    action: aws:runCommand
    onFailure: Abort
    timeoutSeconds: 300
    inputs:
      DocumentName: AWS-RunShellScript
      InstanceIds: ['{{ InstanceId }}']
      TimeoutSeconds: 120
      CloudWatchOutputConfig:
        CloudWatchOutputEnabled: true
        CloudWatchLogGroupName: /ssm/runbooks/app-log-rotation
      Parameters:
        commands:
          - |
            set -euo pipefail
            umask 077
            LOG_DIR="$(realpath -e -- '{{ LogPath }}')"
            case "$LOG_DIR" in
              /var/log/myapp|/var/log/myapp/*) ;;
              *) echo "Refusing to operate outside /var/log/myapp: $LOG_DIR" >&2; exit 1 ;;
            esac
            install -d -m 0700 -o root -g root /var/backups/myapp
            ARCHIVE="/var/backups/myapp/logs-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).tgz"
            tar -czf "$ARCHIVE" -C "$LOG_DIR" .
            tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE" > /dev/null          # verify before deleting anything
            find "$LOG_DIR" -xdev -mindepth 1 -delete
            echo "Rotated $LOG_DIR -> $ARCHIVE"

  - name: RestartService
    action: aws:runCommand
    onFailure: Abort
    timeoutSeconds: 180
    inputs:
      DocumentName: AWS-RunShellScript
      InstanceIds: ['{{ InstanceId }}']
      TimeoutSeconds: 120
      CloudWatchOutputConfig:
        CloudWatchOutputEnabled: true
        CloudWatchLogGroupName: /ssm/runbooks/app-log-rotation
      Parameters:
        commands:
          - |
            set -euo pipefail
            systemctl restart '{{ ServiceName }}'
            systemctl is-active --quiet '{{ ServiceName }}'

  - name: Wait
    action: aws:sleep
    inputs:
      Duration: PT10S

  - name: CheckHealth
    action: aws:executeScript
    onFailure: Abort
    onCancel: Abort
    timeoutSeconds: 120
    inputs:
      Runtime: python3.11
      Handler: handler
      InputPayload:
        instanceId: '{{ InstanceId }}'
      Script: |-
        import boto3

        def handler(events, context):
            ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
            resp = ec2.describe_instance_status(
                InstanceIds=[events['instanceId']], IncludeAllInstances=True)
            statuses = resp.get('InstanceStatuses', [])
            if not statuses:
                raise Exception('Instance not found')
            s = statuses[0]
            result = {
                'state': s['InstanceState']['Name'],
                'instanceStatus': s['InstanceStatus']['Status'],
                'systemStatus': s['SystemStatus']['Status'],
            }
            if result['state'] != 'running' or 'impaired' in (result['instanceStatus'], result['systemStatus']):
                raise Exception(f'Unhealthy: {result}')
            return result
    outputs:
      - Name: Health
        Selector: $.Payload
        Type: StringMap

  - name: Notify
    action: aws:runCommand
    onFailure: Continue
    isCritical: false
    timeoutSeconds: 60
    inputs:
      DocumentName: AWS-RunShellScript
      InstanceIds: ['{{ InstanceId }}']
      TimeoutSeconds: 30
      Parameters:
        commands:
          - curl --fail --silent --show-error --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 10 https://internal-api.example.com/notify
          # If the API uses a private CA, add: --cacert /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/internal-ca.pem
outputs:
  - CheckHealth.Health
```

The path allow-list is the primary defence against injection in this runbook. The `realpath` check runs on the instance as a second layer. It also catches symlinks and `..` segments that get past the pattern.

## Before sharing with other teams

- **Role permissions.** Give the Automation role only what it needs:
  - `ssm:SendCommand` on the `AWS-RunShellScript` document and on the target instances, ideally with a tag condition such as `aws:ResourceTag/App=myapp`.
  - `ssm:GetCommandInvocation`, `ssm:ListCommandInvocations` and `ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation`.
  - `ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus`, which can't be scoped to a resource.
  - CloudWatch Logs write access to the log group used above.
- **Trust policy.** Trust `ssm.amazonaws.com` with `aws:SourceAccount` and `aws:SourceArn` conditions, to prevent the confused-deputy problem.

- **How to share.** Share the document with specific account IDs only, never public. Version it and pin consumers to a version.
